title: Canonical Event
description: A normalized action/audit event produced by a source adapter (Squid, OpenShell, and future sources such as Zeek or endpoint telemetry) and submitted to POST /v1/events. See docs/modular-implementation-plan.md section 3.1.

schema_version.description: Contract version this payload was produced against.

event_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this event.

source_type.description: Adapter that produced this event, e.g. squid, openshell.

actor.description: Agent or process that performed the action.
